done_when: `lib/interview/templates.ts` defines 7-8 simple onboarding questions with single_choice, multi_choice and short_text; every question allows skip and custom input; the name question explicitly says an alias is OK.
`buildWave1Canonical` maps the new questions to elicitation units, target dimensions and provenance without breaking the Wave runtime contract.

Wave 1 does not call a deep sensemaker interpretation; it either produces a host-assembled bridge/acknowledgment or reuses the v3 wave prompt (provided by TASK-016) and degrades gracefully when evidence is thin.
The post-Wave 1 UI (`app/play/page.tsx` or `InsightSlip`) shows a soft, optional upload invitation for resume / MBTI / other, and the existing upload consent and UploadPanel remain usable.
Existing integration tests that reference w1q1-w1q4 are updated, or a compatibility shim keeps old answer shapes from failing.
boundaries: No profiling, scoring, or hidden questionnaire logic.
Do not require real name, phone, ID or any high-sensitivity PII.
Upload remains optional and gated by the existing upload consent.
Do not edit or hardcode prompt prose; rely on TASK-016 for prompt loading.
Wave 1 stays a fixed template; no AI interviewer call for Wave 1.
